title: Forecasting AI’s public-service impact
summary: The CAS framework evaluates complementarity, augmentation, and substitutivity across occupations to support responsible workforce planning.
body_html:
CLEAR’s AI and public-service work uses a retrieval-augmented framework to assess how generative AI may complement, augment, or substitute for task bundles across public occupations.

The aim is to support training, workflow design, safeguards, and strategic workforce planning—not to automate personnel decisions.
